57801.meaning1: seven states of consciousness; seven planes of consciousness

examples.text: cha lokā, cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni. satta lokā, sattaviññāṇaṭṭhitiyo. aṭṭha lokā, aṭṭha lokadhammā.

57804.commentary: (MNa) vipassanāya samannāgato'ti sattavidhāya anupassanāya yutto, sattavidhā anupassanā nāma anicc'ānupassanā dukkh'ānupassanā anatt'ānupassanā nibbid'ānupassanā virāg'ānupassanā nirodh'ānupassanā paṭinissagg'ānupassanā'ti. tā visuddhimagge vitthāritā.

examples.text: purimamūlakāni viya yāva sattavīsatimā ṭhitimūlakasappāyakārīsuttā aṭṭha suttāni pūretabbāni
yā kho, bho, imehi sattah'aṅgehi cittassa ek'aggatā parikkhatā, ayaṃ vuccati, bho, ariyo sammāsamādhi saupaniso iti'pi saparikkhāro iti'pi.

57809.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr pl of sattahākāra

examples.text: tato paraṃ, pañcah'ākārehi anodhisopharaṇā sattah'ākārehi odhisopharaṇā dasah'ākārehi disāpharaṇā'ti ayaṃ vikubbanā, sukhaṃ supatī'tiādayo ānisaṃsā ca mettāyaṃ vuttanayen'eva veditabbā'ti.

57810.meaning1: ascetic who subsists on food from only seven houses
57810.commentary: (DNa) ek'āgāriko'ti yo ekasmiṃ'y'eva gehe bhikkhaṃ labhitvā nivattati… dv'āgārik'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: te ek'āgārikā vā honti ek'ālopikā, dv'āgārikā vā honti dv'ālopikā… satt'āgārikā vā honti satt'ālopikā. ekissā'pi dattiyā yāpenti, dvīhi'pi dattīhi yāpenti… sattahi'pi dattīhi yāpenti.
evaṃ bhāvitesu kho, bhikkhave, sattasu sambojjh'aṅgesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu satta phalā satt'ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā. katame satta phalā satt'ānisaṃsā?
anicc'ānupassan'ādikā satt'ānupassanā sayaṃ tassa tassa paccanīk'aṅgavasena pariccattāhi niccasaññ'ādīhi vimuttattā tadaṅgavimuttī'ti saṅkhyaṃ gacchanti.

57813.meaning1: seven underlying tendencies; seven inherent inclinations
57813.commentary: (PMa) satt'ānusayā'ti kāmarāg'ānusayo paṭigh'ānusayo mān'ānusayo diṭṭh'ānusayo vicikicch'ānusayo bhavarāg'ānusayo avijj'ānusayo. appahīn'aṭṭhena anusentī'ti anusayā.

examples.text: katame satta dhammā pahātabbā? satt'ānusayā, kāmarāg'ānusayo, paṭigh'ānusayo, diṭṭh'ānusayo, vicikicch'ānusayo, mān'ānusayo, bhavarāg'ānusayo, avijj'ānusayo. ime satta dhammā pahātabbā.

57814.meaning1: ascetic who subsists on only seven mouthfuls of food
57814.commentary: (DNa) ek'ālopiko'ti yo eken'eva ālopena yāpeti. dv'āgārik'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: te ek'āgārikā vā honti ek'ālopikā, dv'āgārikā vā honti dv'ālopikā… satt'āgārikā vā honti satt'ālopikā. ekissā'pi dattiyā yāpenti, dvīhi'pi dattīhi yāpenti… sattahi'pi dattīhi yāpenti.

57815.meaning1: realm of existence; abode of beings
57815.notes: ten abodes (see DN 33.12) 1. sattā nānattakāyā nānattasaññino, 2. sattā nānattakāyā ekattasaññino, 3. sattā ekattakāyā nānattasaññino, 4. sattā ekattakāyā ekattasaññino, 5. sattā asaññino appaṭisaṃvedino, 6. sattā ākāsānañc'āyatan'ūpagā, 7. attā viññāṇañc'āyatan'ūpagā, 8. sattā ākiñcāññ'āyatan'ūpagā, 9. sattā n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatan'ūpagā

examples.text: navasu satt'āvāsesu, imesu kho, bhikkhave, navasu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī samma'd'atthaṃ abhisamecca diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti.

yāni kho pana tāni gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭisāyanīyāni bhesajjāni, seyyath'idaṃ, sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, tāni paṭiggahetvā satt'āhaparamaṃ sannidhikārakaṃ paribhuñjitabbāni, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
atha kho bho mahāgovindo brāhmaṇo tassa satt'āhassa accayena kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaji
tena hi bhavaṃ govindo satt'āhaṃ āgametu, yāva mayaṃ sake puttabhātaro rajjena anusāsissāma, satt'āhassa accayena mayam'pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāma, atha yā te gati, sā no gati bhavissatī'ti.

57820.meaning1: business which can be accomplished within seven days
57820.commentary: (VINa) satt'āhakaraṇīyesu, satt'āhakaraṇīyena gantun'ti satt'āh'abbhantare yaṃ kattabbaṃ taṃ satt'āhakaraṇīyaṃ, tena satt'āhakaraṇīyena karaṇabhūtena gantuṃ anujānāmī'ti attho.

57821.meaning1: died a week ago; seven days dead

examples.text: atha kho maṃ, bhikkhave, devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca, satt'āhakālaṅ'kato, bhante, āḷāro kālāmo'ti. ñāṇañ'ca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi, satt'āhakālaṅ'kato āḷāro kālāmo'ti.

57822.meaning1: (of medicine) allowable to be kept for seven days
57822.construction:
satta + aha + kāla + ika
sattāhakāla + ika
57822.commentary: (VINa) sappi'ādi pañcavidhaṃ bhesajjaṃ satt'āhaṃ nidhetabbato satt'āho kālo assā'ti satt'āhakālikaṃ.

examples.text: khādanīyaṃ nāma pañca bhojanāni, yāmakālikaṃ satt'āhakālikaṃ yāvajīvikaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ khādanīyaṃ nāma.

57823.meaning1: one week old; seven days after birth
57823.commentary: (UDa) satt'āhajāte'ti satt'āhena jāto satt'āhajāto. tasmiṃ satt'āhajāte, jātassa sattame ahanī'ti attho.

examples.text: dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, satt'āhajāte bodhisatte bodhisattamātā kālaṅ'karoti tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapajjati. ayam'ettha dhammatā.

ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante! yāva app'āyukā hi, bhante, bhagavato mātā ahosi, satt'āhajāte bhagavati bhagavato mātā kālam'akāsi, tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapajjī'ti.

57824.meaning1: ordained for seven days; renounced for a week

examples.text: sattāhapabbajite kho pana, bhikkhave, rāj'isimhi dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ antaradhāyi.

57825.meaning1: maximum of one week; seven days at the most

examples.text: tāni paṭiggahetvā satt'āhaparamaṃ sannidhikārakaṃ paribhuñjitabbānī'ti satt'āhaparamatā paribhuñjitabbāni.

57826.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of sattāhaparama
57826.meaning1: seven days at most; for a maximum of one week

examples.text: yāni kho pana tāni gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭisāyanīyāni bhesajjāni, seyyath'idaṃ, sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, tāni paṭiggahetvā satt'āhaparamaṃ sannidhikārakaṃ paribhuñjitabbāni, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

57827.meaning1: attained final Nibbāna a week ago
57827.meaning2: attained final Nibbāna seven days ago
57827.commentary: (DNa) ajja satt'āhaparinibbuto samaṇo gotamo'ti ajja samaṇo gotamo satt'āhaparinibbuto.

examples.text: addasā kho āyasmā mahākassapo taṃ ājīvakaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ, disvā taṃ ājīvakaṃ etadavoca, ap'āvuso, amhākaṃ satthāraṃ jānāsī'ti? ām'āvuso, jānāmi, ajja satt'āhaparinibbuto samaṇo gotamo.

57828.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of sattāha
57828.meaning1: for a week; for seven days

examples.text: atha kho brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo satt'āhaṃ buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
tassā dhammaṃ suṇitvāna, yathā maṃ anusāsi sā, satt'āhaṃ ekapallaṅkena, nisīdiṃ pītisukhasamappitā, aṭṭhamiyā pāde pasāresiṃ, tamokhandhaṃ padāliyā'ti.

57829.commentary: (VINa) satt'āh'ātikkante atikkantasaññī nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan'ti sace'pi sāsapamattaṃ hoti sakiṃ vā aṅguliyā gahetvā jivhāya sāyanamattaṃ nissajjitabbam'eva, pācittiyañ'ca desetabbaṃ.

examples.text: idaṃ me, bhante, bhesajjaṃ satt'āh'ātikkantaṃ nissaggiyaṃ, im'āhaṃ saṅghassa nissajjāmī'ti

57831.commentary: (MNt) pañca ahāni bhūtāni etassā'ti pañc'āhito, so eva vāro'ti pañc'āhikavāro. evaṃ satt'āhikavāro'ti veditabbo.

examples.text: tasmā pañcame vā sattame vā divase puna tattha cāretuṃ vaṭṭati, ettakena hi tiṇam'pi paṭiviruhati, udakam'pi pasīdati. ayaṃ pana imaṃ pañcāhikavāraṃ vā satt'āhikavāraṃ vā na jānāti, divase divase rakkhitaṭṭhāne'y'eva rakkhati.

57833.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of sattāhika
57833.meaning1: once every seven days; once a week; (comm) with seven days in-between
57833.construction:
satta + aha + ika + aṃ
sattāhika + aṃ

examples.text: ek'āhikam'pi āhāraṃ āhārenti, dvī'hikam'pi āhāraṃ āhārenti… satt'āhikam'pi āhāraṃ āhārenti. iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikam'pi pariyāya-bhatta-bhojan'ānuyogam'anuyuttā viharantī'ti.

57834.meaning1: which appeared on the seventh day; which becomes available on the sixth day after

examples.text: satt'āh'uppanne mūlacīvare paccāsācīvaraṃ uppajjati, das'āhā kāretabbaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, satti tiṇhaphalā. atha puriso āgaccheyya, ahaṃ imaṃ sattiṃ tiṇhaphalaṃ pāṇinā vā muṭṭhinā vā paṭileṇissāmi paṭikoṭṭissāmi paṭivaṭṭessāmī'ti.
satthahārakaṃ v'āssa pariyeseyyā'ti asiṃ vā sattiṃ vā bheṇḍiṃ vā laguḷaṃ vā pāsāṇaṃ vā satthaṃ vā visaṃ vā rajjuṃ vā.
yo imāhi catūhi disāhi āgamissati samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā, tam'ahaṃ yathāsatti yathābalaṃ paṭipūjessāmī'ti.

57838.meaning1: cage of spears; enclosure of spears
57838.meaning2: cage of spears; wall of spikes
57838.commentary: (DNa) sattipañjaraṃ karitvā'ti sattihatthehi purisehi parikkhipāpetvā. (DNt) sattipañjaran'ti sattikhagg'ādihatthehi purisehi mallarājūnaṃ bhagavato dhātuārakkhakaraṇaṃ sandhāy'āha.

examples.text: atha kho kosinārakā mallā bhagavato sarīrāni satt'āhaṃ sandh'āgāre sattipañjaraṃ karitvā dhanupākāraṃ parikkhipāpetvā naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkariṃsu garuṃ kariṃsu mānesuṃ pūjesuṃ.

57839.meaning1: blow from a spear; javelin strike (in)

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato khamo hoti sattippahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ pharasuppahārānaṃ bheri-paṇava-saṅkha-tiṇava-ninnāda-saddānaṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo khantā hoti.
satt'imā, bhikkhave, dhātuyo. katamā satta?
satt'ime, brāhmaṇa, bojjh'aṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anupakkilesā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimutti-phalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti. katame satta?
satt'ime, bhikkhave, dhammā sapattakantā sapattakaraṇā kodhanaṃ āgacchanti itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā. katame satta?

57842.commentary: (VINa) sattilomavatthusmiṃ so māgaviko ekaṃ migañ'ca sattiñ'ca gahetvā vanaṃ gantvā tassa migassa samīpaṃ āgat'āgate mige sattiyā vijjhitvā māresi, tassa sattiyā vijjhanakabhāvo'y'eva nimittaṃ ahosi. tasmā sattilomapeto jāto.

examples.text: idh'āhaṃ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ sattilomaṃ purisaṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantaṃ. tassa tā sattiyo uppatitvā uppatitvā tass'eva kāye nipatanti.

taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu so puriso tīhi sattisatehi haññamāno tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyethā'ti? ekissā'pi, bhante, sattiyā haññamāno so puriso tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha, ko pana vādo tīhi sattisatehī'ti?

57849.commentary: (MNa) sattisūl'ūpamā vinivijjhan'aṭṭhena. (THIa) sattisūl'ūpamā kāmā'ti kāmā nāma yena adhiṭṭhitā, tassa sattassa vinivijjhanato nisitasatti viya sūlaṃ viya ca daṭṭhabbā.
57849.notes: (BD) the stake of a spear (PED) a sword stake

examples.text: sattisūla-upamā kāmā, khandh'āsaṃ adhikuṭṭanā, yaṃ tvaṃ kāmaratiṃ brūsi, aratī dāni sā mama.
asisūn'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. sattisūla-upamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.

57850.meaning1: like swords and spears; similar to swords and spears

examples.text: sattisūl'ūpamā kāmā, khandh'āsaṃ adhikuṭṭanā, yaṃ tvaṃ kāmaratiṃ brūsi, aratī dāni sā mama.
asisūn'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. sattisūl'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.

57851.meaning2: Chapter 3 of the Devatāsaṃyuttaṃ, Book 1 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

57852.meaning1: meal; flour; (comm) barley or rice flour
57852.commentary: (VINa) sattu nāma sālivīhiyavehi katasattu. kaṅguvarakakudrūsakasīsāni'pi bhajjitvā īsakaṃ koṭṭetvā thuse palāpetvā puna daḷhaṃ koṭṭetvā cuṇṇaṃ karonti.

examples.text: bhojanīyaṃ nāma pañca bhojanāni, odano, kummāso, sattu, maccho, maṃsaṃ.

57853.synonym: diṭṭha, disa, paccatthika, paccāmitta, paṭisattu, paṭisūra, paravādī, veripuggala

examples.text: atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto pañcasu hatthinikāsatesu paccekā itthiyo āropetvā ārohaṇīyaṃ nāgaṃ abhiruhitvā ukkāsu dhāriyamānāsu rājagahamhā niyyāsi
satta pañhā satt'uddesā satta veyyākaraṇānī'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?

57856.meaning1: bag of flour; sack of meal
57856.meaning2: leather bag full of parched flour

examples.text: bahūni ṭhānāni vicintayitvā, yam'ettha vakkhāmi tadeva saccaṃ, maññāmi te brāhmaṇa sattubhastaṃ, ajānato kaṇhasappo paviṭṭho.
samantanemīni sahass'arāni ca, byākaṃsu veyyañjanikā samāgatā, disvā kumāraṃ satapuññalakkhaṇaṃ, parivāravā hessati sattumaddano.

57858.meaning1: with seven bulges; with seven protuberances; sixteenth of the thirty-two marks of a great man
57858.commentary: (MNa) satt'ussado'ti dve hatthapiṭṭhiyo dve pādapiṭṭhiyo dve aṃsakūṭāni khandho'ti imesu sattasu ṭhānesu paripuṇṇamaṃs'ussado assā'ti satt'ussado.

examples.text: satt'ussado kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

57859.meaning1: full of life; crowded with beings
57859.commentary: (DNa) satt'ussadan'ti sattehi ussadaṃ, ussannaṃ bahujanaṃ ākiṇṇamanussaṃ. posāvaniya-hatthi-assa-mora-mig'ādi-anekasatta-samākiṇṇañ'cā'ti attho.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena caṅkī brāhmaṇo opāsādaṃ ajjhāvasati satt'ussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭh'odakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.

57861.meaning1: auspicious mark of having seven bulges

57862.meaning1: theory that a being exists; belief in a permanent entity

examples.text: evarūpañ'hi jānanaṃ satt'ūpaladdhiṃ na pajahati, attasaññaṃ na ugghāṭeti, kammaṭṭhānaṃ vā satipaṭṭhānabhāvanā vā na hoti. imassa pana bhikkhuno jānanaṃ satt'ūpaladdhiṃ pajahati, attasaññaṃ ugghāṭeti, kammaṭṭhānañ'c'eva satipaṭṭhānabhāvanā ca hoti.
tatth'āyaṃ samayo, satthagamanīyo hoti maggo, sāsaṅkasammato, sappaṭibhayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
sace cuto sīlavatato hoti, pavedhatī kamma virādhayitvā, pajappatī patthayatī ca suddhiṃ, satthā'va hīno pavasaṃ gharamhā.

tasmā't'iha, phagguna, tava ce'pi koci pāṇinā pahāraṃ dadeyya, leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dadeyya, daṇḍena pahāraṃ dadeyya, satthena pahāraṃ dadeyya, tatrā'pi tvaṃ, phagguna, ye gehasitā chandā ye gehasitā vitakkā te pajaheyyāsi.
kadā nu paññāmayam'uggatejaṃ, satthaṃ isīnaṃ sahas'ādiyitvā, māraṃ sasenaṃ sahasā bhañjissaṃ, sīh'āsane taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
tassa so bhisakko sallakatto satthena vaṇamukhaṃ parikanteyya. satthena vaṇamukhaṃ parikantitvā esaniyā sallaṃ eseyya.

esanī'ti kho, sunakkhatta, satiyāy'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ, satthan'ti kho, sunakkhatta, ariyāy'etaṃ paññāya adhivacanaṃ, bhisakko sallakatto'ti kho, sunakkhatta, tathāgatass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.

57866.commentary: (SNPa) satthānī'ti kāyaduccarit'ādīni. tāni hi attano paresañ'ca chedan'aṭṭhena, satthānī'ti vuccanti. tesu c'āyaṃ visesato codito musāvacanasatthān'eva karoti. iminā kāraṇen'āhaṃ vibbhanto'ti bhaṇanto.

examples.text: atha satthāni kurute, paravādehi codito, esa khv'assa mahāgedho, mosavajjaṃ pagāhati.
upakkhalitvā vā papateyyaṃ, bhattaṃ vā me bhuttaṃ byāpajjeyya, pittaṃ vā me kuppeyya, semhaṃ vā me kuppeyya, satthakā vā me vātā kuppeyyuṃ

57870.commentary: (ANa) satthakā vā me vātā'ti satthaṃ viya aṅgam'aṅgāni kantantī'ti satthakā.

examples.text: ekako kho pan'āhaṃ araññe viharanto upakkhalitvā vā papateyyaṃ, bhattaṃ vā bhuttaṃ me byāpajjeyya, pittaṃ vā me kuppeyya, semhaṃ vā me kuppeyya, satthakā vā me vātā kuppeyyuṃ, tena me assa kālaṅ'kiriyā, so mam'assa antarāyo, hand'āhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā'ti.

57873.meaning1: which should be travelled with a caravan; which should be travelled in convoy; (or) which should be travelled with a weapon
57873.meaning2: (a path) to be passed with a caravan
57873.commentary: (VIN 2.5.3.7) satthagamanīyo nāma maggo na sakkā hoti vinā satthena gantuṃ.

examples.text: tatth'āyaṃ samayo, satthagamanīyo hoti maggo, sāsaṅkasammato, sappaṭibhayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.

57876.commentary: (DNa) satth'antarakappo'ti satthena antarakappo. saṃvaṭṭakappaṃ appatvā antarā'va lokavināso. antarakappo ca nām'esa dubbhikkh'antarakappo rog'antarakappo satth'antarakappo'ti tividho. tattha lobh'ussadāya pajāya dubbhikkh'antarakappo hoti. moh'ussadāya rog'antarakappo. dos'ussadāya satth'antarakappo. tattha dubbhikkh'antarakappena naṭṭhā yebhuyyena pettivisaye upapajjanti. kasmā? āhāranikantiyā balavattā. rog'antarakappena naṭṭhā yebhuyyena sagge nibbattanti kasmā? tesañ'hi aho vataññesaṃ sattānaṃ evarūpo rogo na bhaveyyā'ti mettacittaṃ uppajjatī'ti. satth'antarakappena naṭṭhā yebhuyyena niraye upapajjanti. kasmā? aññam'aññaṃ balavāghātatāya.

examples.text: dasavass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu satt'āhaṃ satth'antarakappo bhavissati. te aññam'aññamhi migasaññaṃ paṭilabhissanti.

57877.meaningLit: rule about (teaching the Dhamma to someone with) a sword in hand

57878.meaning1: with sword in hand; carrying a knife
57878.commentary: (VINa) satthapāṇimhi'pi es'eva nayo. asiṃ sannahitvā ṭhito'pi hi satthapāṇisaṅkhyaṃ na gacchati.

examples.text: na satthapāṇissa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na satthapāṇissa agilānassa dhammo desetabbo. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca satthapāṇissa agilānassa dhammaṃ deseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

57879.meaning1: rusty sword; blunt weapon; (comm) rust on the sword of wisdom
57879.commentary: (SNa) kodho satthamalan'ti kodho malaggahitasatthasadiso, paññāsatthassa vā malan'ti satthamalaṃ.

examples.text: kiṃsu issariyaṃ loke, kiṃsu bhaṇḍānam'uttamaṃ. kiṃsu satthamalaṃ loke, kiṃsu lokasmim'abbudaṃ.
vaso issariyaṃ loke, itthī bhaṇḍānam'uttamaṃ, kodho satthamalaṃ loke, corā lokasmim'abbudā.
satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hit'esinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya
eso hi bhagavā buddho, nadiṃ nerañjaraṃ pati, sabbadukkhappahānāya, dhammaṃ deseti pāṇinaṃ, tass'āhaṃ santikaṃ gacchaṃ, so me satthā bhavissati.

57881.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
57881.commentary: (MNa) satthā pavattā sarabhaṅgo lomahaṃso ucc'aṅgamāyo'ti ime pañca janā.

examples.text: satthā pavattā sarabhaṅgo lomahaṃso, ucc'aṅgamāyo asito anāsavo, manomayo mānacchido ca bandhumā, tadādhimutto vimalo ca ketumā.

57882.meaning1: in the teacher; in the master

examples.text: evarūpaṃ te, rāhula, kāyakammaṃ satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu desetabbaṃ, vivaritabbaṃ, uttānīkātabbaṃ, desetvā vivaritvā uttānīkatvā āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjitabbaṃ.
yāni kho pan'assa honti sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni jimheyyāni vaṅkeyyāni, tāni yathābhūtaṃ āvikattā hoti satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu.

57883.grammar: masc, loc sg of satthar, loc abs
57883.meaning1: when the master; when the teacher

examples.text: evaṃ sampadam'idaṃ āyasmantānaṃ satthari sammukhībhūte taṃ bhagavantaṃ atisitvā amhe etam'atthaṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ maññatha.
ekasmiñ'hi kāle satthari āḷavinagaraṃ upanissāya agg'āḷave cetiye viharante bahū upāsakā upāsikā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ca vihāraṃ dhammassavan'atthāya gacchanti, divā dhammassavanaṃ hoti.

yathā vā pan'eke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, maṇilakkhaṇaṃ vatthalakkhaṇaṃ daṇḍalakkhaṇaṃ satthalakkhaṇaṃ asilakkhaṇaṃ usulakkhaṇaṃ

57885.meaning1: rough in appearance from being cut into small bits
57885.commentary: (MNa) lūkhacīvaradharo'ti ettha pana lūkhan'ti satthalūkhaṃ suttalūkhaṃ rajanalūkhan'ti tīhi kāraṇehi lūkhaṃ veditabbaṃ. tattha satthena khaṇḍ'ākhaṇḍikaṃ chinnaṃ satthalūkhaṃ nāma, taṃ agghena parihāyati, thūladīghasuttakena sibbitaṃ suttalūkhaṃ nāma, taṃ phassena parihāyati kharasamphassaṃ hoti. rajanena rattaṃ rajanalūkhaṃ nāma, taṃ vaṇṇena parihāyati dubbaṇṇaṃ hoti. (MNt) tattha tattha satthena chinditattā satthalūkhāni.
57885.notes: The commentary suggests that this type of robe made of small pieces is only decreased in value, not in quality or comfort.

examples.text: ahaṃ kho pan'udāyi, app'ekadā gahapaticīvarāni dhāremi daḷhāni satthalūkhāni alābulomasāni.

57886.meaning1: stabbing with a weapon; blow with a sword

examples.text: tañ'ce, āvuso, bhikkhuṃ pare aniṭṭhehi akantehi amanāpehi samudācaranti, pāṇisamphassena'pi leḍḍusamphassena'pi daṇḍasamphassena'pi satthasamphassena'pi.
so evaṃ pajānāti, tathābhūto kho ayaṃ kāyo yathābhūtasmiṃ kāye pāṇisamphassā'pi kamanti, leḍḍusamphassā'pi kamanti, daṇḍasamphassā'pi kamanti, satthasamphassā'pi kamanti.

57887.commentary: (SNa) satthavaṇijjā'ti āvudhabhaṇḍaṃ kāretvā tassa vikkayo… iti sabbam'pi imaṃ vaṇijjaṃ n'eva attanā kātuṃ, na pare samādapetvā kāretuṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: pañc'imā, bhikkhave, vaṇijjā upāsakena akaraṇīyā. katamā pañca? satthavaṇijjā, sattavaṇijjā, maṃsavaṇijjā, majjavaṇijjā, visavaṇijjā.
atha kho, rājañña, tassa aggikassa jaṭilassa etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yena so satthavāso ten'upasaṅkameyyaṃ, app'eva nām'ettha kiñci upakaraṇaṃ adhigaccheyyan'ti.

57889.meaning1: leader of the caravan; company leader
57889.commentary: (MNa) jāti-kantār'ādi-nittharaṇ'atthāya veneyya-sattha-vāhana-samatthatāya satthavāho. (THa) veneyyasattānaṃ saṃsārakantārato nibbānaṃ paṭivāhan'aṭṭhena satthavāhe.

examples.text: uṭṭhehi vīra vijitasaṅgāma, satthavāha aṇaṇa vicara loke, desassu bhagavā dhammaṃ, aññātāro bhavissantī'ti.
taṃ maṃ tato satthavāho, ussannāya vipulāya vaḍḍhiyā, okaḍḍhati vilapantiṃ, acchinditvā kulagharasmā.

57891.commentary: (VIN 1.1.3) ettha haratī'ti hārakaṃ. kiṃ harati? jīvitaṃ. atha vā haritabban'ti hārakaṃ, upanikkhipitabban'ti attho. satthañ'ca taṃ hārakañ'cā'ti satthahārakaṃ.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, satthahārakaṃ v'āssa pariyeseyya, maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya
te iminā kāyena aṭṭīyamānā harāyamānā jigucchamānā satthahārakaṃ pariyesanti.
satthaṃ, āvuso sāriputta, āharissāmi, n'āvakaṅkhāmi jīvitan'ti.
dasa'pi bhikkhū ek'āhena satthaṃ āharanti, vīsam'pi bhikkhū ek'āhena satthaṃ āharanti, tiṃsam'pi bhikkhū ek'āhena satthaṃ āharanti.
atha kho āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahācundo āyasmantaṃ channaṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamiṃsu. atha kho āyasmā channo acirapakkantesu tesu āyasmantesu satthaṃ āharesi.

57894.grammar: masc, agent, nom sg of satthar
57894.commentary: (MNa) aho nūna te so bhagavā satthā'ti sabrahmacārī tāva te evaṃmah'iddhiko, so pana te bhagavā satthā aho nūna mah'iddhiko'ti satthu iddhipāṭihāriyadassane jāt'ābhilāpā hutvā evam'āhaṃsu.

examples.text: sabbalokā ca me mano vuṭṭhahissati, nibbāne ca santadassāvī bhavissāmi, anusayā ca me samugghātaṃ gacchissanti, kiccakārī ca bhavissāmi, satthā ca me pariciṇṇo bhavissati mettāvatāyā'ti.
yo vo, ānanda, mayā dhammo ca vinayo ca desito paññatto, so vo mam'accayena satthā.

es'ev'anto rāg'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto paṭigh'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto diṭṭh'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto vicikicch'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto mān'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto bhavarāg'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto avijj'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto daṇḍ'ādāna-satth'ādāna-kalaha-viggaha-vivāda-tuvaṃtuvaṃ-pesuñña-musāvādānaṃ

57897.meaning1: relying on weapons; supported by swords
57897.commentary: (ANa) sesapadesu pan'ettha ayam'adhippāyo, brāhmaṇā tāva mante labhitvā laddhapatiṭṭhā nāma honti, gahapatikā yaṃkiñci sippaṃ, itthī kuladāyajjasāmikaṃ puttaṃ, corā yaṃkiñci āvudhasatthaṃ, samaṇā sīlaparipuṇṇā laddhapatiṭṭhā nāma honti. tasmā mant'ādhiṭṭhānā'tiādīni vuttāni.

57899.meaning1: due to the teacher; by means of the master

examples.text: satthāravasena dutiyanayabhūmiparicchedo niṭṭhito.
